mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment above 6% in 3 months triggers negative 20-day S&P 500 returns due to reduced consumer confidence and investment.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses the threshold, or returns revert positively within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices predicts stronger economic expansion, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns (IC < 0.05) when both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise concurrently, or returns decline despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery regimes, sustained FEDFUNDS below 1% for two months signals robust monetary policy, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when in post-shock recovery regime, or IC <0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Steady monthly increases in PAYEMS (job growth) over three months predict positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as market anticipates sustained labor demand.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive when PAYEMS rises, or p-value >0.05 in walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: A 10% monthly drop in GDPC1 (demand) triggers negative 20-day S&P 500 returns due to contractionary economic signals.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative when GDPC1 drops 10%, or p>0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) alongside falling unemployment (UNRATE) in an expansionary convergence regime predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive despite rising GDPC1 and falling UNRATE in expansionary regimes, or IC <0.03 over 1-year.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO exceeding its 100 baseline by 5 points in a month triggers negative 5-day S&P 500 returns as market anticipates over-supply.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not negative when INDPRO hits threshold, or p>0.05 in t-test.
